targets.title: The collaborative roots of corruption.
targets.evidence_quote: In Study 1, we conducted a preregistered replication study 1 of their Aligned outcomes condition to test whether their effect generalizes to students used to participating in psychological but not economic studies (see Simons, Shoda, & Lindsay, in press).
targets.outcome_quote: Here, we report two preregistered studies that replicate the original findings, but with a smaller effect size. Moreover, our findings suggest that context moderates corruption in collaboration.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that their two studies replicate the original findings with smaller effects. They did not include the Individuals condition, so their later statement that they did not replicate the collaboration-versus-solitary contrast describes an untested claim, not a contradictory result.
